name: Todra Gorge loop over the plateau
why: Through the narrowest part of the gorge between 300 m walls, then up a mule path to the nomad plateau and down past Berber villages and palm groves.
book: Free; local guides at the gorge entrance. Taxi from Tinghir (15 km).
water: Cafes at the gorge; nothing on the plateau.
dangers: Heat from June to September: walk early, carry 2-3 litres.

points.name: Todra Gorge
points.note: The narrow gorge between pink limestone walls.

points.name: Todra plateau
points.note: A stony high plain where nomad families camp.
